Privacy policy

Accel Saathi, our answer to Project Udyam Digital · built by team TouristGuide, NIT Jamshedpur, for the Airtel Sync 2026 case competition · last updated 31 October 2026

Accel Saathi is a student prototype that helps a small business choose internet, phone and business services, verify its documents and track its order, in the app or on WhatsApp. "Accel Telecom" is the fictional operator from the case brief. No real connection is sold, and no payment is taken.

What we collect, and why

  • Chat messages you send to the advisor (in the app or on WhatsApp), to recommend a bundle and answer your questions.
  • Business details you give: type of business, city, team size, number of sites, GSTIN. Used only for the recommendation and the quote.
  • KYC documents and fields (GST certificate, Udyam certificate, address proof), only after you consent, and only to check them against the registry.
  • Your mobile number, only if you agree to WhatsApp order updates. It is used for nothing else, is stored apart from the order, and is shown masked (last 4 digits) everywhere, including our logs.

WhatsApp

When you message our WhatsApp number, Meta delivers the message to our server so the advisor can answer. If you placed an order and agreed to updates, we send you a message at each stage of the order. You can reply STATUS, RESCHEDULE or PROBLEM. We answer about an order only to the numbers linked to it.

AI

Some messages are passed to an AI model (Google Gemini or Groq) to understand free text. Prices and products are always decided by fixed rules, never by the AI. Before any text leaves for the AI, your phone number, GSTIN, PAN, Aadhaar, e-mail and business name are replaced with tokens such as [PHONE_1], and put back only in the reply you see. We never send document images to the AI. In production the same open-source model runs inside Accel's own cloud.

Who sees your data

Only the project team, for running and improving the prototype. We do not sell or share your data, and we do not use it for advertising.

How long we keep it, and deleting it

Data is kept while the prototype runs, and the whole prototype database is deleted after the competition ends. In the app you can erase a conversation that has no order placed. To delete anything else, including WhatsApp chats, send "DELETE MY DATA" to our WhatsApp number, and the team removes your data within 7 days.

Security

Your details are encrypted where they are stored (AES-256-GCM), so a copy of our database shows nothing readable, and records looked up by your phone number are stored under a coded key instead of the number. All traffic uses HTTPS. WhatsApp webhooks are checked against Meta's signature. Keys are kept out of the code.
